# Close failed compaction output streams explicitly

On failed mbox compaction, close the destination stream so its temporary file is removed before the folder can be discovered as an Inbox-1 style folder. The review found that waiting for the SafeOutputStream destructor did not clean up in time; also close if the safe-stream query fails.

Scope: message store compaction.

Paths:

- `mailnews/local/src/nsMsgBrkMBoxStore.cpp`

## Evidence

[Shared lesson record](../records/7815d3f8da125ec6891bb102ab02ebaf963e02e5fccb039154496f7bf7b3bea4.json).

- https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1923526
- https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/6b7ec98fb911309d53f481deb60de60805f21faa
- https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D227571

Source record: `1ef6871c8604be668f02fef6523841ad6d9bd3007c70501b934d7439bc6dc26a`

~~~
mDestStream->Close();  // Clean up temporary file.
~~~

## Validation and limits

Status: **supported**. This backfill preserves earlier findings and their uncertainty. It does not count unstudied commits as complete. Historical test outcomes remain reported outcomes. No runtime tests or builds were rerun for publication.

Supporting source excerpts and references are included in the shared records.
